newsitem.title: YEMEN: Saudi calls for curbs on Yemeni opposition.
newsitem.headline: Saudi calls for curbs on Yemeni opposition.

text.p: Yemen's President Ali Abdullah Saleh said on Wednesday that Saudi Arabia had asked Yemeni opposition leaders to stop using the kingdom as a base from which to launch media campaigns against Sanaa.
Saleh told a news conference that Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan "informed the exiled Yemeni opposition to stop their media campaign and animosity against Yemen."
Prince Sultan visited Yemen in August in the first high level visit between the two countries since their ties soured over differences which arose during the 1991 Gulf War.
Former leaders in southern Yemen fled the country after their bid to secede from the north during Yemen's 1994 civil war failed. Some of them set up an opposition group.
Yemen and Saudi Arabia recently signed a security cooperation agreement and Saleh said work on demarcating their border was proceeding normally.
